newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha demand weak, but paper market gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha demand weak, but paper market gains.

text.p: NWE paper naphtha prices talked higher on Monday despite weaker crude, but traders said that the thinly-talked physical market was fundamentally weak.
Nov swaps talked at $223/$224 a tonne cif NWE with Dec $6 in backwardation.
"I don't think swaps can hold the market up," said a trader.
Demand from petchem consumers was seen waning as end-users switch to condensate, now a cheaper feedstock than naphtha.
Barges were offered at quotes cif high evens, fob ARA, but discussion on the cargo market was quiet.
